title_en: Rebuttal to the Theory of Proving Limits for Almighty God (Part 1)
description_en: Rebuttal to the theory of proving limits for Almighty God, Part 1. The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: A critical examination and refutation of theological positions that attribute physical limits or boundaries to God.
